name: CAD and 3D printing
description: Design a part, slice it and print it.

apps.name: FreeCAD
apps.why: Parametric 3D design, for parts that have to fit.

apps.name: OpenSCAD
apps.why: Designs a part from code, so a change is one number.

apps.name: Blender
apps.why: Models and repairs meshes, and renders them.

apps.name: PrusaSlicer
apps.why: Turns a model into instructions for the printer.

apps.name: OrcaSlicer
apps.why: A slicer with calibration tools for many printers.

apps.name: UltiMaker Cura
apps.why: Another slicer, with settings for many printers.
